title: Peer‐Supported Open Dialogue as an Approach to Deliver Treatment as Usual Within an Adult Specialist Eating Disorder Service: A Case Study
abstract: ABSTRACT This case study looks at how peer‐supported open dialogue (POD) was initially introduced within an adult specialist eating disorder service. It considers how the voices of the service user and their family network were heard and responded to and how this has laid the foundation for developing the POD approach as treatment as usual within this service.

journal.name: Australian and New Zealand Journal of Family Therapy
